# Jeeshma Prakash

> Web developer, UI/UX designer and entrepreneur based in Kerala, India. Co-founder of Blackbox Learning (edtech) and software developer at PRception (product/engineering studio). Builds full-stack websites, product interfaces and content that convert.

Jeeshma Prakash works across the stack — from interface design to backend architecture — and also takes on independent UI/UX design and content creation projects. Focus: functional, polished, genuinely enjoyable-to-use products.

## Facts

- Name: Jeeshma Prakash
- Roles: Web Developer, UI/UX Designer, Entrepreneur, Co-Founder
- Location: Kerala, India
- Companies: Blackbox Learning (co-founder), PRception (software developer)
- Tech stack: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Python, Django, Tailwind, Bootstrap, GSAP, Three.js, AWS, Figma
- Contact: jeeshma@blackboxlearning.in, jeeshma@prception.in
